test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Three of the following statements pertaining to non-biodegradable plastics indicate their implications on animals, plants and our surrounding. Choose the odd one out.

options.text: Plastic bags are durable carry bags
Reduce the fertility of the soil
Can prove fatal when eaten by animals

solution:
The correct answer is __**Plastic bags are durable carry bags**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plastic bags are durable carry bags** is the odd one out as it does not indicate any negative implications on animals, plants, or our surroundings.
 
• **Choking the drains** is a significant environmental issue caused by non-biodegradable plastics, leading to waterlogging and sanitation problems.
 
• **Reducing the fertility of the soil** is an adverse effect of plastic waste, as it can hinder water absorption and root growth.
 
• **Proving fatal when eaten by animals** highlights the severe threat plastics pose to wildlife, often leading to death due to ingestion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Non-biodegradable plastics are a major environmental concern as they do not decompose naturally and persist in the environment for hundreds of years.
 
• Efforts are being made globally to reduce plastic usage, promote recycling, and develop biodegradable alternatives to mitigate these issues.
 
• Public awareness and government regulations play a crucial role in addressing the environmental impacts of plastic pollution.
